name: motion-showreel
description: Make stunning short videos entirely in code (5-60s, up to ~2 min for music-driven pieces): showreels, product films, UI motion, kinetic typography, logo stings, generative loops, era-spanning retrospectives. Deterministic render(t) pages rendered frame by frame with Playwright + ffmpeg; a 22-style library used as a starting point (adapt, mix or write your own); two audio tiers (built-in synth, Tone.js with sampled instruments) sharing one timeline with the picture; one checkpoint with three directions when no style is given; programmatic technical acceptance kept separate from human review.
